  - text: CLASS 9 · TRIANGLE PROOFS
  - heading "Triangle Inequality" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Three positive lengths form a triangle if and only if the sum of any two is greater than the third.
  - text: 24 min INTERMEDIATE VISUAL EXPLORATION geometry2d
  - navigation:
    - button "INTERACT"
    - button "LEARN"
    - button "EXAMPLE"
    - button "FORMULA"
    - button "PRACTICE"
  - main:
    - heading "1. BUILD A TRIANGLE" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Drag the segment sliders or type values. Then drag the segments into the triangle to test.
    - navigation:
      - button "▣ Triangle view"
      - button "▤ Number line view"
      - button "▱ Clear triangle"
    - complementary:
      - heading "Segment lengths" [level=3]
      - text: Side a
      - slider "Side a": "4"
      - spinbutton "Side a value": "4"
      - text: Side b
      - slider "Side b": "5"
      - spinbutton "Side b value": "5"
      - text: Side c
      - slider "Side c": "8"
      - spinbutton "Side c value": "8"
      - heading "Presets" [level=3]
      - 'button "Example: 4,5,8"'
      - 'button "Degenerate: 3,4,7"'
      - 'button "Equilateral: 6,6,6"'
      - button "Reset":
        - img
        - text: Reset
    - button "a = 4"
    - button "b = 5"
    - button "c = 8"
    - text: →
    - region "Triangle construction drop zone":
      - img "Triangle segment drop zone"
      - paragraph: Drag all three segments here to build the triangle
    - img
    - text: Valid triangle! All three inequalities are satisfied.
    - strong: Perimeter = 17
    - heading "2. CHECK THE TRIANGLE INEQUALITY" [level=2]
    - paragraph: All three inequalities must be true.
    - article:
      - heading "a + b > c" [level=2]
      - strong: 4 + 5 > 8
      - text: ←
      - img
      - text: →
      - paragraph: 9 > 8
      - text: "True"
    - article:
      - heading "a + c > b" [level=2]
      - strong: 4 + 8 > 5
      - text: ←
      - img
      - text: →
      - paragraph: 12 > 5
      - text: "True"
    - article:
      - heading "b + c > a" [level=2]
      - strong: 5 + 8 > 4
      - text: ←
      - img
      - text: →
      - paragraph: 13 > 4
      - text: "True"
    - img
    - text: If any one of these is false or equal, the segments cannot form a non-degenerate triangle.
    - article:
      - heading "3. WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: If one inequality fails, one side is too long to “reach” the other two. The figure collapses into a straight line or two overlapping sides.
      - text: "Equality (degenerate): a + b = c Inequality fails: a + b < c"
      - strong: ⓘ Three positive lengths form a triangle if each pair sum is greater than the third.
    - article:
      - heading "4. WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - 'heading "Valid triangle: 4, 5, 8" [level=3]'
      - img: 4 5 8
      - paragraph: ✓ 4 + 5 = 9 > 8; ✓ 4 + 8 = 12 > 5 ✓ 5 + 8 = 13 > 4
      - text: All true → Triangle exists.
      - separator
      - 'heading "Degenerate (invalid): 3, 4, 7" [level=3]'
      - img "Triangle inequality number line": a b c
      - paragraph: 3 + 4 = 7 = 7 ×
      - text: One equality → No triangle (flat).
    - article:
      - heading "COMMON MISTAKE" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: COMMON MISTAKE
      - heading "Checking only the two shortest sides is not enough." [level=3]
      - text: "× Mistake: 2 + 3 > 4"
      - paragraph: "Example: 2, 3, 4 2 + 3 = 5 > 4 (true) But 2 + 4 = 6 > 3 (true) 3 + 4 = 7 > 2 (true) Actually this set works."
      - text: ✓ Correct rule
      - paragraph: All three pair sums must be strictly greater than the third. Use >, not ≥.
    - heading "6. CHALLENGE" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Let two sides be 5 and 9. What integer values can the third side take? Find all integers x such that a triangle can be formed.
    - button "0"
    - button "1"
    - button "2"
    - button "3"
    - button "4"
    - button "5"
    - button "6"
    - button "7"
    - button "8"
    - button "9"
    - button "10"
    - button "11"
    - button "12"
    - button "13"
    - button "14"
    - button "15"
    - paragraph: x ≤ 4 (invalid) 4 < x < 14 (valid) x ≥ 14 (invalid)
    - complementary:
      - heading "Solution" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "We need both: |9 − 5| < x < 9 + 5"
      - strong: 4 < x < 14
      - paragraph: "Integers: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13"
      - paragraph: There are 9 possible integer values.
